metadata.description: JimalH's shared Claude Code mods, installable on any machine.

plugins.name: jimal-progress
plugins.description: Mod: progress bar above the prompt with each open task, its own bar and time left; follows the session task list, folds while you type, leaves 30 s after it finishes; plus an agents panel (/agents-info). Fork of savvy-progress.

plugins.name: jimal-session
plugins.description: Mod: one line above the prompt with the prompt cache countdown and session/week time and usage left, plus Keep warm and Auto-handoff (handover note) switches.

plugins.name: jimal-mods
plugins.description: Mod: /mods panel to turn installed plugins and mods on and off, browse your marketplaces and install from them.

plugins.name: jimal-filetree
plugins.description: Mod: IDE-style file tree (/filetree) that also marks the files Claude plans to change, is changing and has changed, opens their folders, shows a legend, and counts lines changed outside git. Fork of filetree.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: Mod (external, by Kurt Buhler, MIT): IDE-style file tree pane with git status, lines changed, and Claude's reads/writes/git activity shimmering on files (/filetree). Pinned to the reviewed commit 6bc23f6 (v0.5.2).
